docs/subagents.md:79: Before each turn, the parent's system prompt carries an `<advertised_subagents>` block: every discovered agent (built-ins + your `.md` files, minus any that set `advertise: false`) with its name and description, plus the one-sentence delegation policy. This is how the model *knows* your project agents exist without guessing names — previously only `general` and `explore` were named in the tool description, and a typo'd agent name cost a corrective round-trip.
